source: The room was a rather traditional affair.
target: Camera erat more traditionali instituta.

source: The building itself was made of stone, with wooden inlays and floors.
target: Aedificium ipse ex lapide factum erat, cum inserta lignaria et pavimenta.

source: The walls were adorned with simple scrolls or basic paintings.
target: Parietes erant ornati volumina simplicia aut picturis rudimentariis.

source: Nothing that screamed wealth, more like it whispered about an overworked interior designer who ran out of ideas after the reception hall.
target: Nihil ostendebat opulentiam clamantem; potius quasi susurrabat de designatore interiore nimis laborato, qui post atrium receptionis consilia exhauriverat.

source: Sam hung the small sign, that told people that a ritual was taking place on the doorknob, then after making sure that the door was locked behind him, he turned to the room, ignoring it for a moment as Lucky curiously sniffed around, and took in the ritual room.
target: Sam parvum signum suspendit, quod populo indicabat ritu in manubrio ostii agi, et postquam certus fuit ostium post se clausum esse, ad cameram se vertit, eam per momentum neglegens dum Lucky curiosus circum quaerebat et spatium rituosum intuens erat.

source: A simple stone surface, elevated slightly in the middle, surrounded by wooden flooring, that was found everywhere else in the building.
target: Superficies lapidea simplex, in medio parum elevata, circumdata pavimento ligneo, ubique in aedificio reperta est.

source: Next to the walls were several desks, empty, with only one covered with simple writing utensils and a few reams of parchments.
target: Iuxta parietes erant plura mensae, vacuae; solum una erat instructa instrumentis scribendi simplicibus et paucis fasciculis chartarum.

source: And next to the door, on the wall, was a small cabinet that, according to the booklet Sam was given, contained some basic ritual materials that were needed in almost every ritual.
target: Et iuxta ostium, in pariete, parvus armarium apponebatur, qui, secundum libellulum quem Sam accepit, contineret quaedam materialia rituum fundamentalia quae fere in omni ritu necessaria erant.

source: Chalk, salt, and a few more reagents and such.
target: Creta, sal, et nonnulla alia reagentia.

source: On the ceiling was a dark hole, right above the short stone plinth in the middle of the room.
target: In laqueariis erat fovea obscura, recta supra brevem plinthum lapideum in medio camerae.

source: ‘Probably for ventilation or maybe it opens and allows the sky to be seen…’ he wondered as he curiously gazed at it.
target: «Forsitan ad aerationem aut fortasse aperitur, ut caelum videatur…» miratus est dum eo curiosus aspiciebat.

source: But in the end, he just shook his head and took out the booklet.
target: Sed in fine, caput dimovit et libellulum extraxit.

source: Thankfully, it contained the basic ritual that the natives of the world called Evolution Ritual.
target: Gratias Deo, continebat ritum fundamentalis, quem indigenae mundi Ritus Evolutionis vocabant.

source: Naturally, there were better and more intricate rituals, but he was in a position where he could only use this.
target: Naturaliter, meliores atque intricati ritus exstabant, sed talibus conditionibus tantum hoc uti posset.

source: Opening the cabinet, he retrieved some chalk, gave Lucky some snacks to allow him to work without distraction, then began drawing the ritual circle on the stone platform.
target: Armarium aperiens, cretam extraxit, Lucky esculenta dedit ut sine perturbatione laboraret, deinde circulum rituosum in superficie lapideo delineare coepit.

source: One big circle to encompass the ritual, and setting a boundary for the magic.
target: Unus ingens circulus ad ritum complectendum, finemque magiae statuens.

source: Then a smaller circle, with even smaller circles placed on it, equidistant from each other to hold the reagents.
target: Deinde parvus circulus, super quem circuli minores aequo intervallo distributi ad reagentia colligenda erant.

source: Followed by a few important runes between the two concentric circles.
target: Sequebantur paucae magni momenti runae inter duo circulos concentricos.

source: Coincidentally, one of the runes that he drew was one he already knew.
target: Casualiter, una ex runis quas delineavit, erat illa quam iam noverat.

source: The rune of magic.
target: Runa magiae.

source: After all, this ritual was nothing more than channeling the mana of the world through certain filters, the reagents, into the pet or familiar, to evolve them.
target: Postremo, hic ritus nihil aliud erat quam canalizatio mana mundi per certos filtros—reagentia—in animal domesticum, ut evolvantur.

source: It took him around an hour to draw all the runes out painstakingly, ignoring how every time he perfected one, his notification chimed in that he learned a new rune.
target: Ei circiter hora tulit ut omnes runas diligentissime delinearet, neglegens quotienscumque una conficiebatur, notitia eius nuntians novam runam didicisse.

source: He would have turned it off, but the notification was needed to tell him when he was finished with a rune.
target: Illud suppressisset, sed notitia necessaria erat ut ei indicaret cum runa confecta esset.

source: Then, after the ritual circle was fully applied to the stone, Sam took a quick breather, making sure he was as ready for the ritual as he could be.
target: Deinde, postquam circulus rituosus in lapide plene delineatus est, Sam brevem spiritum sumpsit, curans se tam paratum ad ritum esse quam poterat.

source: Then he simply stepped up to Lucky, lifted the silly wolf into the circle, then squatted down, and looked directly into his eyes.
target: Deinde ad Lucky accessit, ineptum lupum in circulum sustulit, deinde genu flectens, in oculos eius directe respexit.

source: “Okay, Lucky! I need you to stay, veeery still! Alright?”
target: «Bene, Lucky! Te requireo ut maneas, valde quietus! Ita?»

source: The wolf looked at him for a moment, then simply licked his face.
target: Lupus per momentum in eum respexit, deinde faciem eius simpliciter lambivit.

source: As Sam cleaned the slobber off his face, he hoped it was the lick of agreement.
target: Dum Sam saliva ex facie abstergit, sperabat illud esse lambitum consensum.

source: Sam watched Lucky for a moment, and when he saw that the young wolf had no intention of leaving the ritual circle, he let out a relieved sigh and began walking around the ritual circle.
target: Sam Lucky per momentum observavit, et cum vidit iuvenem lupum non propositum esse circulum rituosum relinquere, suspiravit leviter et circa circulum rituosum ambulare coepit.

source: In the smaller circles, he began placing the reagents.
target: In circulis minoribus, reagentia disponere coepit.

source: Into the bottom two went a small shadow wolf fang and a tuft of Lucky’s own fur.
target: In duo inferiores posita sunt parva canina lupae umbratilis et fasciculus pilorum Lucky ipsius.

source: The next two received the blood of the swamp shadow murks, which were creatures from the swamp that blended into the shadows from where they ambushed their victims.
target: Duo proximis accipiunt sanguinem paludis umbra murkorum, creaturarum ex palude quae in umbras se miscebant ad hostes insidiandos.

source: And the top two received two tiny pieces of mithril.
target: Et duo superiora acceperunt duas parvas partes mithrili.

source: Finally, at the top, into the seventh circle, he placed the bottle of the fractured Lesser Shadow Spirit essence.
target: Denique, in circulum septimum, amphoram essentiae fractae Minoris Umbrae Spiritus posuit.

source: Originally, he planned to hunt down a Shadow Murk, but this was much better.
target: Primum intendebat murkum umbratilem venari, sed hoc multo melius fuit.

source: Now he just had to pray to the RNG gods that he chose the correct reagents, and Lucky would get the skills he wanted.
target: Nunc tantum oportuit deos RNG orare, ut recta reagentia eligeret, atque Lucky artes quas optabat adeptus esset.

source: Stepping around the wolf sitting still, curiously gazing at the surrounding stuff, he kneeled down behind the ritual circle and placed one hand on the shadow wolf’s fang and the tuft of fur.
target: Circumstantem lupum immobile sed curiose intuens, post circulum rituosum genu flectit et unam manum super caninam lupae umbratilis atque fasciculum pilorum posuit.

source: Then Sam took a deep breath and began channeling mana.
target: Tum Sam profundum spiritum arripuit atque mana canalizare coepit.

source: He closed his eyes and concentrated fully on the mana as it left his body, making sure to extract every last ounce of mana from his body.
target: Oculos clausit et totum animum ad mana intentum habuit dum ex corpore eius effluere videbatur, curans ut omnem quantitatem manae eodem extraheret.

source: With his senses he followed as the mana flowed from his hands into the items he was touching, saturating them, then following the circle drawn with chalk continued into the runes, filling them, causing them to shine strong enough that he could feel them through closed eyes, then continued into the next circle.
target: Sensibus suis secutus est, dum mana ex manibus eius per ea quae tetigit fluere inciperet, ea saturans; deinde circulum creta delineatum sequens in runas versus, eas replebat, ita ut valde fulgere vellent ut per clausos oculos sentiret, atque deinde in circulum sequentem perveniebat.

source: Watching through his mind’s eye, he waited as his mana infused the blood, then continued to travel further in the circle.
target: Mentis oculo intuens, exspectavit dum mana in sanguinem infusa esset, deinde per circulum ulterius procedere coepit.

source: The pieces of mithril barely took a second to fill with mana, proving their capability with conducting mana, and then his mana reached the most important reagent.
target: Partes mithrili paulo tempore ad manae repletionem suffecerunt, ostendentes earum facultatem mana conducendi, et tunc mana eius ad reagentia maximi momenti pervenit.

source: The shadow spirit, however fractured, still had its own mana, so for a moment that felt like years, Sam felt his mana straining against the spirit’s own mana, the two warring against each other.
target: Spiritus umbra, quamvis fractus, attamen proprium manae retinebat, ita ut per momentum, quod quasi annos videbatur, Sam sensit mana suum adversus spiritus conari, duo inter se certantes.

source: Thankfully, the mind was destroyed by its defeat, so Sam only had to dominate the instincts that were inherent in such a being.
target: Gratias Deo, mens eius in clade deletus erat, ita Sam solum debuit instinctus in ea entitate innatos dominare.

source: But in the end, it was just a fractured remnant of a weak spirit, so he managed to overwhelm it.
target: Sed demum, illa erat tantum fracta reliquio spiritus infirmi, quapropter eum superare potuit.

source: And the moment the spirit’s defenses broke, Sam felt the ritual circle complete, and the drain on his mana increased.
target: Et momento quo defensionēs spiritus confractae sunt, Sam sensit circulum rituosum finitum esse, atque deiectio manae eius augeri.

source: He didn’t hesitate and gave everything freely.
target: Non dubitavit et omnia libere donavit.

source: After all, he was investing in the future, so he couldn’t afford to be stingy.
target: Nam in futurum investiebat, ergo non poterat esse avarus.

source: Plus, it was just mana, it would regenerate.
target: Praeterea, erat solum mana, quae regenerabitur.

source: So, he dug deep, dragged up every last mote of mana, and channeled it into the circle.
target: Itaque alte fodiit, omnem remanentem particulam manae eduxit, et eam in circulum canalizavit.

source: Meanwhile, the circle, which previously shone with light, began to turn dark, and as he opened his eyes, he saw as if the very darkness was swallowing the light, birthing… shadows.
target: Interim, circulus, qui antea lumine fulgebat, obscurari coepit, et cum oculos aperuit, vidit quasi ipsa tenebra luce devoranda esset, umbras gignens.

source: Shadows danced on the wall, and even though the room had a few windows, they were obscured by the shadows that seemed to be erupting randomly from Lucky, who became a big ball of darkness that seemed to be pulsating to a weird beat.
target: Umbrae in pariete saltabant, et quamquam camera paucis fenestris praedita erat, illae obscuratae erant ob umbras quae fortasse ex Lucky, qui in magnum globum tenebris versum est ac ad pulsus insolitos vibrare videbantur, erumpere videbantur.

source: It took Sam a moment to recognize that it was beating to the rhythm of his own heart.
target: Sam paulum temporis requisivit ut agnosceret illud ad rhythmon cordis sui pulsare.

source: For a while, he just knelt there, and watched, amazed, the spectacle as mana was drained out of him as soon as it regenerated.
target: Aliquamdiu, ibi genu flectens, stupens spectabat spectaculum dum mana eique inmomentaneē effluebatur simul ac regenerabatur.

source: After an unknown amount of time, the pulsating dark mass began to die down in intensity, and the dark ball of nothingness in the middle of the room began to shrink.
target: Post quantitatem temporis incertam, massa obscura pulsans incipiebat minuere in intensitate, atque globus tenebricosus nullitatis in medio camerae contrahere coepit.

source: Soon it lost its globular shape and began to take the familiar shape of Lucky, albeit a little smaller.
target: Mox formam globularis amisit et formam Lucky notam assumpsit, quamquam paulo minorem.

source: Lucky’s body, instead of sinfully fluffy fur, was made of black shadows that seemed to dance a little every time Lucky twitched.
target: Corpus Lucky, pro lanugine peccatori ex pilis abundanti, ex umbris nigris factum erat, quae parum saltabant quotidie cum Lucky leviter convulsus esset.

source: Otherwise, it was still shaped like a wolf and had the same adorable face.
target: Alioquin adhuc in forma lupi erat atque eundem vultum amoenum habebat.

source: For an entire minute, they stared at each other, then at the same time a multitude of notifications popped up, and Sam felt himself being hit by exhaustion that he had never felt, and Lucky pounced on him and began licking his face.
target: Per totum minutum inter se aspiciebant; deinde simul multitudo notificationum apparuit, et Sam sensit se ab extenuatione, quam numquam ante sentirat, affictum, dum Lucky in eum desiluit et faciem eius lambere coepit.

source: Sam couldn’t help but laugh out loud, then bury his face into Lucky’s fur.
target: Sam nesciebat non subridere voce clara, deinde faciem in lanugine Lucky sepelit.

source: Thankfully, it was still as soft as previously, more like it was even softer and more delicate.
target: Gratias Deo, adhuc tam mollis erat quam antea, immo etiam suavior atque tenerior.

source: For a moment he let himself loose in the sensation of Lucky’s fur and played with his friend, but then, still laying on the ground, exhausted, he began going over his notifications.
target: Per momentum se relaxavit in sensu lanugine Lucky et cum amico luderet, sed deinde, adhuc iacens in terra et extenuatus, notificationes suas recensere coepit.

source: [Congratulations, you have correctly recorded an entire Rune scheme!]
target: [Gratulor, totum schema runarum recte consignatum habes!]

source: [You’ve learned the Rune of Direction!]
target: [Runa Directio didicisti!]

source: [You’ve learned the Rune of Health!]
target: [Runa Salutis didicisti!]

source: [You’ve learned the Rune of Control!]
target: [Runa Dominii didicisti!]

source: [You’ve learned the Rune of Assimilation!]
target: [Runa Assimilationis didicisti!]

source: [You’ve learned the rune scheme of the Ritual of Evolution!]
target: [Schema runarum Rituum Evolutionis didicisti!]

source: That little addition to his rune dictionary was a nice bonus.
target: Illa parva additio ad dictionarium runarum eius bonus gratiosus erat.

source: He would have to get some skill that would be able to make use of it.
target: Debebat aliquam artem adipisci, qua ea uti posset.

source: Though if the exhaustion meant what he suspected it did, then he would have enough time at a library to get the skill.
target: Si extenuatio id significabat, quod suspicabatur, tunc satis temporis in bibliotheca habebat ad artem adipisci.

source: [You attempted the Ritual of Evolution with your pet, Lucky!]
target: [Ritualem Evolutionis cum tuo domestico, Lucky, conatus es!]

source: [Compatibility check…]
target: [Examinatio compatibilitatis…]

source: [Your Ritual of Evolution was a success!]
target: [Ritualem Evolutionis tuam feliciter perfecisti!]

source: [Lucky, the Adult Gray Mana Wolf (Level 15) has successfully transformed into Juvenile Shadow Spirit Wolf (Level 1)!]
target: [Lucky, Lupus Manae Caesi Adultus (Gradus 15) feliciter in Lupum Spiritus Umbrae Juvenilem (Gradus 1) se transformavit!]

source: [Lucky lost the Strong Jaw skill!]
target: [Lucky, artem Mandibulae Fortis perdit!]

source: [Lucky gained the Animalistic Shadow Control skill!]
target: [Lucky artem Controlli Umbrarum Animalisticam adeptus est!]

source: [Animalistic Shadow Control: Level Max (Passive) The wolf controls the shadows around him just as easily as it breathes.]
target: [Controllus Umbrarum Animalisticus: Gradus Maximus (Passivus) – Lupus umbras circa se regit aeque facile quam spirat.]

source: [Lucky gained the Shadow Spirit Body skill!]
target: [Lucky artem Corporis Spiritus Umbrae adeptus est!]

source: [Shadow Spirit Body: Level Max (Passive) The body of the wolf is part shadow and part spirit, which makes it much more malleable.]
target: [Corpus Spiritus Umbrae: Gradus Maximus (Passivus) – Corpus lupi est parte umbra et parte spiritus, quod id multo flexibilis reddit.]

source: [Name: Lucky Race: Juvenile Shadow Spirit Wolf HP: 945/945 MP: 285/285 Level: 1 STR: 21 DEX: 25 AGI: 30 VIT: 21 END: 18 MAG: 19 PER: 31 WIS: 14 LUK: 7]
target: [Nomen: Lucky Genus: Lupus Spiritus Umbrae Juvenilis HP: 945/945 MP: 285/285 Gradus: 1 Virtus: 21 Agilitas: 25 Celeritas: 30 Vigor: 21 Patientia: 18 Magia: 19 Perceptio: 31 Sapientia: 14 Fortuna: 7]

source: Sam read the skills and couldn’t help but celebrate.
target: Sam artes legit et non potuit non celebrare.

source: He got the skill he wanted!
target: Artem, quam desiderabat, adeptus est!

source: Granted, he was just aiming for the Shadow Body skill, which was a well-known pet skill in his inherited memories, but the addition of the Spirit prefix couldn’t hurt.
target: Certe, tantum ad artem Corporis Umbrae contendebat, quae nota erat ut ars domestica in memoria hereditata, sed additio praefixi Spiritus nullum nocuit.

source: And the stats…
target: Et statuta…

source: They were amazing, showing clearly that without the evolution ritual, poor Lucky stood no chance.
target: Ea erant miranda, evidenter ostendentes quod sine ritu evolutionis, pauper Lucky nullam spem habebat.

source: Then, while scratching behind Lucky’s ears, he started reading the notifications about his own skills.
target: Deinde, dum post aures Lucky scalpens, notificationes de propriis artibus legere coepit.

source: [You have successfully finished the first ritual you ever tried! You gained +1 MAG and +1 WIS!]
target: [Priorem ritualem quam umquam temptavisti feliciter perfecisti! +1 MAG et +1 WIS consecutus es!]

source: [Thanks to keeping calm during the ritual, the Basic Breathing Technique reached Level 8!]
target: [Gratias ad calmum animum in ritu manendum, Technica Basica Spiritus ad Gradum 8 pervenit!]

source: [Advanced Mana Control reached Level 6!]
target: [Imperium Manae Provectum ad Gradum 6 pervenit!]

source: [Mana Sense reached Level 11!]
target: [Sensus Manae ad Gradum 11 pervenit!]

source: [You gained the Focused Sense subskill!]
target: [Subdisciplina Sensus Concentrati adeptus es!]

source: [Focused Sense: Level 0/5 (Passive) The more you concentrate your sense on something, the more you can sense.]
target: [Sensus Concentratus: Gradus 0/5 (Passivus) – Quo arctius sensum ad aliquid intendis, eo amplius percipies.]

source: [Multitasking reached Level 22!]
target: [Multitasking ad Gradum 22 pervenit!]

source: [Mana Synergy reached Level 4!]
target: [Synergia Manae ad Gradum 4 pervenit!]

source: [Thanks to drawing deep and long from your well of mana, keeping nothing back, and supporting your companion, your Mana Well skill reached Level 3!]
target: [Gratias ad profunde et diuturne ex puteo manae trahendum, nihil retinendo, et comitem tuum sustinendo, ars Putei Manae ad Gradum 3 pervenit!]

source: [Calm Heart reached Level 5!]
target: [Cor Tranquillum ad Gradum 5 pervenit!]

source: [Your skill Companion Sense and its subskill, Deep Connection, transformed upon your companion’s evolution!]
target: [Ars Sensus Comitis tui et eius subdisciplina, Connexio Profunda, in evolutione comitis tui transformata sunt!]

source: [Companion Sense and Deep Connection transformed into the skill, Spirit Link!]
target: [Sensus Comitis et Connexio Profunda in artem, Vinculum Spirituum, transformatae sunt!]

source: [Spirit Link: Level 0/100 (Passive) You have a connection to a spirit, and this connection is based on the deep bond you two share. It allows you to know the location of the spirit and their feelings and gives you a general idea about their wellbeing. The spirit is capable of the same. (Still provides the bonuses of the subsumed skills.)]
target: [Vinculum Spirituum: Gradus 0/100 (Passivus) – Habes nexum ad spiritum, et hic nexus fundatur in profunda vincula quae inter vos existunt. Permittit te scire locum spiritus atque affectus eius, atque notionem generalem de eius salubritate praebet. Spiritus quoque eadem efficit. (Adhuc praebet beneficia subdisciplinarum condescendatarum.)]

source: Sam stared for a long minute at the notifications happily, but then his smile turned into a frown as he beheld the last notification that popped up.
target: Sam diuturno momento notificationes laete intuens, deinde risus eius in rugam conversus est cum ultimam notificationem apparuisse vidit.

source: [Due to overdrawing your mana, you have been struck by Mana Exhaustion!]
target: [Propter nimiam extractionem manae, afflictus es Exhauritione Manae!]

source: [Mana Exhaustion: Physical abilities -90%, Mana Control -90%, Mana Regeneration -90%, Using mana could result in all manner of other negative effects. Duration: 99 hours 49 minutes]
target: [Exhaustio Manae: Facultates Corporales -90%, Imperium Manae -90%, Regeneratio Manae -90%, Uti manam potest ducere ad alias nocivas effectus. Duratio: 99 horae 49 minuta]

source: Which neatly explained why he was feeling so exhausted.
target: Quod satis explicavit cur tam extenuatus se sentirentem.

source: Sam scowled a little, but then shrugged.
target: Sam paulum scowlavit, sed deinde umeros levavit.

source: He already suspected that it would be the case, as nothing was free.
target: Iam suspicabatur hoc futurum esse, quoniam nihil gratis est.

source: And Ironwood’s library was much better than the one back in Greenwood, so he had things to do while recovering, but it still felt shitty.
target: Et bibliotheca Ironwood multo melior erat quam illa in Greenwood, itaque res agendas habebat dum convalescebat, sed tamen misere se sentiebat.

source: But before he could do anything, he had to check something.
target: Sed antequam quidquam agere posset, aliquid inspexi debuit.

source: Carefully he sat up, still patting Lucky, then took a deep breath and called out to the changed wolf.
target: Cautissime sedebat, Lucky adhuc palpans, deinde profundum spiritum arripuit et ad lupum mutatum clamavit.

source: “Hey, Lucky!” the wolf immediately looked up, eagerly waiting for his words.
target: «Heus, Lucky!» lupus statim oculos elevavit, avidus verbis eius exspectans.

source: “Could you do me a favor and jump into my shadow?”
target: «Potesne mihi commodum facere et in umbram meam salire?»

source: The wolf cocked his head to the side, as if contemplating his request, but then barked out happily and jumped up and, with a picture-perfect dive, jumped into the shadow his sitting body was making on the wooden floor.
target: Lupus caput ad latus inclinavit, quasi petitionem considerans, sed deinde laetus latravit et desiluit, et cum perfecta deiectio, in umbram quam corpus sedentem in pavimento ligneo creabat, saliit.

source: For a moment the shadow was still, then two big eyes opened and began staring at him as if expecting praise.
target: Per momentum umbra immobilis manebat, deinde duo magna oculi aperti sunt et eum intuentes quasi laudem exspectantes perspexerunt.

source: He wasn’t one to hold back.
target: Non cunctabatur.

source: “Good boy!”
target: «Bonus, puer!»

source: After cleaning up the ritual room, one of those little things that made NPCs hate the players for if not done, he left the room, told the receptionist that he was finished, and left the mage tower.
target: Postquam cameram rituosam purgavit – una ex illis parvis rebus quae NPCs lusores odisse faciebant si non pergerentur – egressus est, receptori dixit se finem attigisse, et turrim magicarum reliquit.

source: If anyone noticed that he left without the wolf he entered with, then nobody mentioned it.
target: Si quis animadvertisset eum sine lupo quo intraverat discessisse, de hoc nihil dictum est.

source: Lucky, thankfully, managed to understand the concept of staying in his shadow to ambush people, though he expected to have to explain a lot in the future why his shadow was staring at people, or panting.
target: Lucky, gratiose, intellexit notionem mansisse in sua umbra ad hostes insidiandos, quamquam exspectabat se multum de hoc in futurum explanandum esse.

source: It was still much better than the person who did in the other timeline, and from whom he got the idea.
target: Hoc tamen multo melior erat quam persona quae in altera linea temporis egisset, a qua idea orta est.

source: That person was a fan of tentacles…
target: Ea persona tentaculorum cultor erat…

source: Knowing that he was exhausted mentally, and his in-game body was pretty much useless, he took out the letter he got from the owner of the Green Stump, checked the address, and began walking towards it.
target: Scire se mente extenuatum et corpus in ludo fere inutiliter esse, litteras quas a domino “Green Stump” accepisset extraxit, inscriptionem comprobatam quaesivit, et in eam viam procedere coepit.

source: Sam navigated through the winding streets of Ironwood for a while until he found himself standing in front of a three-story building with the same iron and wooden decorations that were present everywhere else in the city.
target: Sam per vias flexuosas Ironwood aliquantum erravit, donec se coram aedificio tribus ordinibus stantem invenit, quo ornamenta ferrea et lignaria, quae ubique in urbe erant, praesente erant.

source: Over the door hung a sign proclaiming the building to be the Cloudy Day inn.
target: Super ostium pendebat signum, quod aedificium nominaretur “Hospitium Diei Nubili.”

source: ‘Weird name…’ Sam thought, but then shrugged.
target: «Nomen insuetu…» cogitavit Sam, sed deinde umeros sublevavit.

source: Sarah was nice and had a rather eccentric name for her inn.
target: Sarah benigna erat et hospitii sui nomen satis eccentricum habebat.

source: Stepping through the door, he was immediately hit by the scent of well-made food and the sound of chatter as people enjoyed the aforementioned food.
target: Per ostium ingrediens statim odor cibi bene parati et sonus sermonum eum percuterunt, dum homines cibum praedictum gaudebant.

source: Dodging people as they rushed around, taking note of a few beautiful women, that seemed to delight in displaying themselves, he stepped up to the counter, manned by a bored man, dressed in slacks and a white shirt.
target: Turba evitans et paucas feminas pulchras, quae se ostendere vellebant, notans, accessit ad mensam, qua vir taediosus, in braccis et alba camisia indutus, praefuit.

source: “Hello, sir, and welcome to the Cloudy Day! How can we help you today?” came the bored greeting, the man barely taking the effort to look at him.
target: «Salve, domine, et gratum te habemus ad “Cloudy Day”! Quomodo tibi hodie auxiliari possumus?» inquit vir taediosus, vix conatus ad eum spectans.

source: Sam just gave the man a smile.
target: Sam viro tantum subridens obtulit.

source: “Greetings, I’m here to deliver a letter to…” he looked down at the letter and then back at the man.
target: «Salve, adsum ut epistulam tradam…» inquit, epistulam intueriens deinde ad virum revertit.

source: “…Andrea.”
target: «…Andrea.»

source: The man let out a deep and long-suffering sigh, nodded, then turned around leisurely and walked through the door behind the counter.
target: Vir profundum et longum suspirium edidit, annuit, deinde lente conversus per ostium post mensam ambulavit.

source: A minute later, the door slammed open, and a big woman, with black hair, put up in a delicate bun, wearing what Sam would call a stereotypical barmaid dress.
target: Post unum minutum, ostium repente patefactum est, et magna femina, capillis nigris in subtili nodum convolutis, vestem gerens, quam Sam “vestimentum tabernariae ministrae” appellaret, apparuit.

source: “It is, I, Andrea!” she exclaimed, standing proudly at the door, while the receptionist just sighed behind her.
target: «Ego, Andrea, sum!» exclamavit, stantibus superbe ad ostium, dum receptrix post eam suspiravit.

source: Sam, now, could understand a little better the man’s attitude.
target: Sam nunc melius mores viri intellexit.

source: “Who has the letter for me?” She continued to yell, looking around until her eyes found Sam.
target: «Quis mihi epistulam dat?» perstabat clamare, circumspiciens donec oculi eius Sam invenirent.

source: “That would be me, madam!” he stated humbly, then held out the letter.
target: «Ego sum, domina!» humiliter dixit, deinde epistulam protulit.

source: “It’s from Greenwood.”
target: «Ex Greenwood est.»

source: The woman’s eyes lit up and she practically teleported next to Sam, snatching the letter from his hands.
target: Oculi mulieris fulserunt et statim ad Sam accessit, epistulam ex manibus eius arripiens.

source: “Oh, Sarah! I haven’t heard from her for a while!” Then she fell silent as she got absorbed in reading the letter.
target: «O, Sarah! Nuper ab ea nullum nuntium audivi!» Deinde siluit, dum epistulam legere occupata esset.

source: A minute later, she silently folded the letter and slipped it into a pocket on her dress, and turned towards Sam with a small, mischievous smile.
target: Post unum minutum, tacite epistulam plicavit et in sinum vestis suae introduxit, et ad Sam versa parvo, malitioso risu.

source: “So, I heard you are looking for a room?”
target: «Itaque audivi te quaerere cubiculum?»
